_readme: Hand-editable source for the tool lists. scripts/build_tools.py joins this with the pages on disk and writes data/tools.json, the generated regions in index.html, tools.html and the seven district pages. A page with no entry here still appears (title and description from the page), with a warning. To feature a tool, set featured to true: featured tools come first on the district page and fill the cards on the home page.

districts.title: Biking Tools
districts.blurb: Two cycling tools: tire air volume with temperature effects, and weather advice for a ride.

districts.title: AI & LLM Tools
districts.blurb: Viewers for Claude logs and responses, in-browser search, model experiments and LLM cost tables.

districts.title: Web & File Utilities
districts.blurb: File and link tools that run in the browser: PDF compress and extract, OCR, CSV to Excel, photo scanner.

districts.title: Deep Zoom
districts.blurb: Large things on one zoomable plane: Bach's chorales, a code repository and two maps of Norway.

districts.title: Fun & Games
districts.blurb: Games, generative toys and phone gadgets: a space shooter, a ball maze, fractals, a generative radio.

districts.title: Bluesky Tools
districts.blurb: Bluesky and ATProto pages: search, list builders, thread viewers, file transfer and blog-post widgets.

districts.title: Etc
districts.blurb: Charts, a visual essay on AI deployment, and a QR label maker for lost property.
